title: Rear Window

scenesThatPass:
LISA: It could be -- the knife, and the saw.
STELLA: Call Lieutenant Doyle!
LISA: No -- let's wait. Let's wait until it gets dark. I'll go over and dig it up!

LISA: And the last thing she'd leave behind would be her wedding ring! Do you ever leave yours at home?
STELLA: The only way anybody could get that off would be to chop my finger -- Let's go down and find out what's buried in the garden.
LISA: Why not? I always wanted to meet Mrs. Thorwald.

first.text: The time -- 7:15 A. M. , WOR, New York. The temperature, outside, 84 -- Friends -- is your life worth one dollar?

last.text: Oh, no thanks -- I don't want any of part of her What did I say?

plot: Professional photographer L.B. "Jeff" Jefferies breaks his leg while getting an action shot at an auto race. Confined to his New York apartment, he spends his time looking out of the rear window observing the neighbors. He begins to suspect that a man across the courtyard may have murdered his wife. Jeff enlists the help of his high society fashion-consultant girlfriend Lisa Fremont and his visiting nurse Stella to investigate.
